definitions.gloss: to have a meal, to dine
definitions.explanation: A regular occasion of eating; the food eaten at such an occasion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一緒|いっしょ}に→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧しません⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Would you like to have a meal together?

examples.english: I value the time I spend having meals with my family.

notes:
⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧ refers to the act of eating a meal or to a meal itself. Slightly more formal than ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧, which is the everyday word for meals.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {食事|しょくじ}する

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {食事|しょくじ}する/⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to have a meal
- ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: during a meal
- ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧: light meal
- ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: dietary restriction

MEAL TYPES:
- ⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧/⟦{朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}→朝ご飯：02843_asagohan⟧: breakfast
- ⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧/⟦{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧: lunch
- ⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧/⟦{夕|ゆう}ご{飯|はん}→夕ご飯：27817_yuugohan⟧: dinner

REGISTER:
⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧ is used in both spoken and written Japanese but carries a slightly formal tone. In everyday conversation, ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧ or ⟦{飯|めし}→飯：03805_meshi⟧ (casual, masculine) are more natural.
